# Making Sense

> > Making Sense provides personalized chemistry tutoring and educational resources for Singapore students preparing for O-Level and A-Level examinations.

Making Sense specializes in small group chemistry lessons with exam-focused preparation strategies. The platform offers both paid tutoring services and free learning resources, while also providing guidance on effective study practices and educational technology use for Singapore students.

## Key Topics

- Chemistry tutoring
- Personalized learning
- A-Level Chemistry
- O-Level Chemistry
- Small group lessons
- Exam preparation
- Singapore education
- Digital learning
- Educational technology
- Free learning resources
- Student's Learning Space
- Google Classroom
- Study tips
- MOE Digital Literacy Programme
- Chemistry materials

## Core Services

- [Get Personalised Chemistry Learning- Making Sense](https://www.makingsense-sg.com/personalised-learning/): Personalized chemistry tutoring with small group lessons and exam prep
- [Free Learning Resources | Making Sense](https://www.makingsense-sg.com/free-learning-resources/): Free chemistry videos for A-Level, O-Level, and secondary science

## Study Tips & Educational Technology

- [Electronic Devices in Learning: The Pros and Cons](https://www.makingsense-sg.com/electronic-devices-in-learning/): Explores pros/cons of digital devices in education with study tips
